---
applyTo: "templates/**"
---

# Templates Ownership

Templates should express the architecture cleanly without dragging in repo-specific assumptions.

Treat templates as scaffolds, not live doctrine.

Make required adaptation obvious and keep wording generic.

Point to the starter kit when users need a fuller copyable example.

Templates should teach the same model as the public guidance without copying all of its detail.

## Follow-Through Triggers

If a change under `templates/**` alters what adopters should copy or adapt, update the guidance that explains that template.
